title: (PDF) Beta-Glucan as a Novel Functional Fiber: Functional Properties, Health Benefits and Food Applications
abstract:
Throughout the literature, it has been shown that the induction of TRIM using such inducers as the BCG vaccine and β-glucan can provide protection through altered immune responses against a range of viral infections.
Untapping the potential of algae for β-glucan production: A review of biological properties, strategies for enhanced production and future perspectives ... Manish S. Bhoyar ... β-Glucan, a naturally occurring polymer of glucose, is found in bacteria, algae, fungi, and higher plants (barley, oats, cereal seeds).
Throughout the literature, it has been shown that the induction of TRIM using such inducers as the BCG vaccine and β-glucan can provide protection through altered immune responses against a range of viral infections. Here we hypothesize a potential role for β-glucan in decreasing worldwide morbidity and mortality due to COVID-19, and posit several ideas as to how TRIM may actually shape the observed epidemiological phenomena related to COVID-19.
Regarding health, β-glucan and phenolic compounds have shown potential in lowering cholesterol and blood glucose levels, as well as in the prevention of diabetes. Therefore, increased attention should be given to β-glucan, a crucial water-soluble dietary fiber with various biological activities such as regulating sugar and lipid metabolism, enhancing immune activity, and modulating gut microbiota.
We also evaluate the potential effects of β-glucan in relation to the immune dysregulation and cytokine storm observed in COVID-19.
